header.title: SpaceX's record BESS and behind-the-meter power deployment lifts power equipment suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: SpaceX tracks 8GW+ of behind-the-meter capacity via deals with FTAI, Solaris and others, and is installing 5.9GWh of BESS (largest US deployment) at Colossus 2.
SpaceX solves its power-on-the-fly needs by orchestrating gas and oversized BESS, with Tesla likely becoming more than a BESS merchant. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
Turbine, BESS and substation suppliers to SpaceX see volume demand, but the article does not quantify supplier revenue.
